## What does the pack do?

One sentence, outcome-first (for example: "turn a sales CSV into a summary plus one anomaly flag").

## What does it prove?

Which Huitzo capability does a developer learn from it (storage, HTTP, email, governance, dashboards)?

## Deterministic vs AI

What does deterministic Python own, and where is the model actually needed? (A pack that is only an LLM call is out of scope here.)

## Rung

Which tier does it fit, and why?
